library(gt)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

islands_mini <-
  tibble(name = names(islands), size = islands) |>
  arrange(desc(size)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

islands_mini |>
  gt(rowname_col = "name") |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Large Landmasses of the World",
    subtitle = "The top ten largest are presented"
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(source_note = "Source: The World Almanac and Book of Facts, 1975, page 406.") |>
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md("Reference: McNeil, D. R. (1977) *Interactive Data Analysis*. Wiley.")
  ) |>
  tab_stubhead(label = "landmass") |>
  fmt_integer(columns = size)

airquality_mini <- airquality |> head(10) |> mutate(Year = 1973L) airquality_mini |> gt() |> tab_header( title = "New York Air Quality Measurements", subtitle = "Daily measurements in New York City (May 1-10, 1973)" ) |> tab_spanner( label = "Time", columns = c(Year, Month, Day) ) |> tab_spanner( label = "Measurement", columns = c(Ozone, Solar.R, Wind, Temp) ) |> cols_move_to_start(columns = c(Year, Month, Day)) |> cols_label( Ozone = html("Ozone,
ppbV"), Solar.R = html("Solar R.,
cal/m2"), Wind = html("Wind,
mph"), Temp = html("Temp,
°F") )

# Get vectors of 2-letter country codes for each region of Oceania
oceania <- list(
  Australasia = c("AU", "NZ"),
  Melanesia = c("NC", "PG", "SB", "VU"),
  Micronesia = c("FM", "GU", "KI", "MH", "MP", "NR", "PW"),
  Polynesia = c("PF", "WS", "TO", "TV")
)

# A named vector mapping country to region (e.g. AU -> Australasia)
country_to_region <- setNames(rep(names(oceania), lengths(oceania)), unlist(oceania))

wide_pops <-
  countrypops |>
  filter(country_code_2 %in% names(country_to_region), year %in% c(2000, 2010, 2020)) |>
  mutate(region = country_to_region[country_code_2]) |>
  select(country_name, region, year, population) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = population) |>
  arrange(desc(`2020`))

wide_pops |>
  gt(rowname_col = "country_name", groupname_col = "region") |>
  tab_header(title = "Populations of Oceania's Countries in 2000, 2010, and 2020") |>
  tab_spanner(label = "Total Population", columns = everything()) |>
  fmt_integer()

towny_mini <- towny |> select(name, website, density_2021, land_area_km2, latitude, longitude) |> arrange(desc(density_2021)) |> slice_head(n = 10) |> mutate( url_name = paste0("[", name, "](", website, ")"), location = paste0( "[map](http://maps.google.com/?ie=UTF8&hq=&ll=", latitude, ",", longitude, "&z=13)" ) ) towny_mini |> select(url_name, location, land_area_km2, density_2021) |> gt(rowname_col = "url_name") |> tab_header( title = "The Municipalities of Ontario", subtitle = "The top 10 highest population density in 2021" ) |> tab_stubhead(label = "Municipality") |> fmt_markdown(columns = c(url_name, location)) |> fmt_number(columns = c(land_area_km2, density_2021), decimals = 1) |> cols_label( land_area_km2 = html("land area,
km2"), density_2021 = html("density,
people/km2") )

sza_pivot <-
  sza |>
  filter(latitude == 20, tst <= "1200") |>
  select(-latitude) |>
  drop_na() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = tst, values_from = sza, names_sort = TRUE)

sza_pivot |>
  gt(rowname_col = "month") |>
  data_color(
    domain = c(0, 90),
    palette = c("orange", "white", "#663399"),  # R has no rebeccapurple
    na_color = "white"
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Solar Zenith Angles from 05:30 to 12:00",
    subtitle = html("Average monthly values at latitude of 20°N.")
  ) |>
  sub_missing(missing_text = "")

coffee_sales <-
  jsonlite::stream_in(
    file("../data/great-tables/examples/coffee-sales.ndjson"),
    verbose = FALSE
  ) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  unnest_wider(monthly_sales, names_sep = "_")

coffee_sales |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header("Sales of Coffee Equipment") |>
  tab_spanner(label = "Revenue", columns = starts_with("revenue")) |>
  tab_spanner(label = "Profit", columns = starts_with("profit")) |>
  cols_label(
    revenue_dollars = "Amount",
    profit_dollars = "Amount",
    revenue_pct = "Percent",
    profit_pct = "Percent",
    icon = "",
    product = "Product"
  ) |>
  # formatting ----
  fmt_number(
    columns = ends_with("dollars"),
    suffixing = TRUE,
    pattern = "${x}",
    n_sigfig = 3
  ) |>
  fmt_percent(columns = ends_with("pct"), decimals = 0) |>
  # style ----
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "aliceblue"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = starts_with("revenue"))
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "papayawhip"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = starts_with("profit"))
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = product == "Total")
  ) |>
  cols_nanoplot(
    columns = starts_with("monthly_sales_"),
    plot_type = "bar",
    new_col_name = "monthly_sales",
    new_col_label = "Monthly Sales"
  ) |>
  fmt_image(columns = icon, path = "../data/great-tables/examples/coffee-table-icons/") |>
  sub_missing(missing_text = "")
